objectives: In this course, you will learn to write academically about works of literature. This includes close reading skills, developing argumentative essays, and the basics of research and incorporating secondary sources into your writing.
content: We will read one novel and one book of poems in this course to achieve the course objectives. The texts will be announced in the Summer.
books: Students should purchase the two books.
